I am 50 years old and I have farmed these same 6 mu in Quzhou County for 30 years. I only finished primary school, but I know this land better than any book. My son works in a factory in the city, so it is just me and my wife managing the field. We have a well for irrigation, but pumping costs electricity, so every time I turn on the pump I feel the money leaving my pocket.

Last year my wheat got about 480 kg per mu and my maize got about 530 kg per mu. This year I will start from what I did last year and make small adjustments. I watch my neighbor Old Wang. He has 8 mu and always gets good wheat. He buys improved wheat seed from the township seed station and hybrid maize seed. I will buy the same kinds. The input dealer told me fertilizer prices did not go up much, so I will not cut back. I would rather spend a bit more on fertilizer than risk a bad harvest — a bad harvest is a disaster, but wasting some fertilizer is just a cost.

For my 6 mu of winter wheat: I will rotary till the field before sowing in October. For base fertilizer I put down about 50 jin of compound fertilizer per mu. Then I top-dress with urea twice — once at green-up and once at jointing. That comes to about 18 kg of nitrogen, 6 kg of phosphorus, and 4 kg of potassium per mu. I will irrigate three times: wintering water, jointing water, and grain-filling water. I spray pesticide twice, once when the aphids show up and once if I see rust. If the weather is normal I expect about 500 kg per mu.

For my 6 mu of summer maize: Right after we harvest wheat in early June, I direct-seed the maize into the wheat stubble without ploughing. No-tillage saves me the machine fee and three days of labor, which matters because I need to get the maize in fast before the rains stop. I put about 40 jin of compound fertilizer in the furrow at planting, then top-dress urea at the big trumpet stage. That is about 16 kg nitrogen, 5 kg phosphorus, and 3 kg potassium per mu. Summer usually brings some rain, so I only irrigate once, at flowering if it turns dry. I spray twice for corn borer and armyworm. I expect about 520 kg per mu.

My budget is tight because we only have two people and my son's factory wage is not big. But I know that if I cheap out on fertilizer now, I will regret it at harvest time.
